artworks.title: The Erinyes
artworks.description: Vázquez paints the Furies as a Spanish Mannerist trio — Megaera with Alecto and Tisiphone as winged tormentors, the named Erinyes of the later mythographic lists.

artworks.title: Orestes Pursued by the Furies
artworks.description: Bouguereau’s Academic nightmare packs the Erinyes around the matricide — Megaera among the sisters whose names Apollodorus and Hyginus list as the jealous punishers of blood-guilt.

popCulture.title: Inferno IX (Megaera)
popCulture.creator: Dante Alighieri
popCulture.description: Dante names Megaera with her sisters on the walls of Dis — the Fury of jealousy as a medieval gatekeeper of the City of Hell.

popCulture.title: Hades
popCulture.creator: Supergiant Games
popCulture.description: Supergiant’s underworld roguelike makes Megaera a recurring Fury boss — the jealous Erinys as whip and dialogue in the House of Hades.
